claims.claim_text: GitHub 稱內部基準測試的寫入吞吐量最高提升 35 倍。
claims.evidence: In internal benchmarks, it has delivered up to 35 times higher write throughput

claims.claim_text: 新設計把權威資料搬到 Azure Blob Storage ... 只有 ref 更新需要共識
claims.evidence: Authoritative repository data lives in Azure Blob Storage ... The part of a push that truly needs agreement is the reference update itself.

claims.claim_text: 參數 763B、context 1M token，權重以 MIT 授權釋出
claims.evidence: 763B params; context_window 1M tokens; This repository and the model weights are licensed under the MIT License.

claims.claim_text: Terminal-Bench 4.0 從 31.2 升到 42.3，DeepSWE v1.1 從 74.2 升到 77.0，並稱縮短了任務執行時間與輸出長度
claims.evidence: Terminal-Bench 4.0: old 31.2, new 42.3; DeepSWE v1.1: old 74.2, new 77.0; 'the model reduces task execution time and output length'; 'is a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash'
claims.note: Attributed to the card; page gives no architecture, as post says.

claims.claim_text: 相較直接移植的基線，端到端訓練吞吐量最高提升 1.5 倍，貢獻已上游到 PyTorch、Triton 與 ROCm。
claims.evidence: up to 1.5x improvement in end-to-end training throughput ... upstreamed to the open-source PyTorch, Triton, and ROCm ecosystems

claims.claim_text: 這篇 arXiv 論文有 58 位作者 ... MI350X 的 HBM 容量是 B200 的 1.6 倍
claims.evidence: Haoyu Zhang and 57 other authors; 1.6x HBM capacity relative to B200; a heterogeneous fleet comprising NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and proprietary MTIA accelerators

claims.claim_text: 這顆晶片的控制 ROM 有 1648 條微指令，共用碼裡連續有 18 個條件分支
claims.evidence: holding the 1648 micro-instructions that control the chip; 18 conditional branches in a row to handle numerous special cases
claims.note: Lede no longer says '一開頭'; 18 branches in a row confirmed by direct read.

claims.claim_text: 文章引述 Intel 文件，加法比 8086 快將近 100 倍。
claims.evidence: speeding up addition by a factor of almost 100 ... performance comparison of the 8087 versus floating-point operations emulated on the 8086 (Intel documentation)
claims.note: Comparison is vs software-emulated FP on 8086; post does not say this.

claims.claim_text: Meta 說 GEM ... 新架構 Kunlun 在相同運算規模下「delivers 2x performance gains」。Component Skip Connection 在品質損失可忽略下減少 43% 的 FLOPS，端到端訓練效率提升一倍，MFU 達 20% 到 25%。
claims.evidence: Kunlun delivers 2x performance gains with the same computation scaling. / we reduce FLOPS by 43% with negligible quality loss. / End-to-end training efficiency is doubled to 20-25% model FLOPS utilization (MFU).

claims.claim_text: 文章列出轉換率提升 18.9%、點擊率提升 12%，但沒有說明評估方法，知識轉移增益的基準在文中也有兩種寫法。
claims.evidence: 18.9% conversion improvement and 12% ad click-through rate (CTR) improvement. Knowledge transfer: 'achieving 2x of transfer effectiveness beyond knowledge distillation' vs 'it doubles the intelligence transfer together with the knowledge distillation deployed in the previous version'
claims.note: Round 1: 'Meta internal evaluation' and 'contradictory' overstated the source. Corrected; round 2 re-check: 18.9%/12% confirmed, no methodology described, two differently-worded transfer statements exist (2x beyond distillation vs doubles together with the previous version's distillation).

claims.claim_text: Filippo Valsorda ... 獎金經捐款增至 36,864 美元；他說由一支來自 Anthropic 的十人團隊在 10 月 15 日領走，並捐給 ISRG。
claims.evidence: tripled to "$36,864 (36 Ki$)"; ten people from Anthropic; claim made "on October 15th, 2026, at 01:07:51 UTC"; donated to ISRG
claims.note: Post hedges with 「他說」, matching a first-party single-author source. Date is UTC.

claims.claim_text: 種子來自 POSIX drand48，以 1997 至 98 年的 Unix 時間戳播種、逐一嘗試，而不是傳說中被遺忘的英文句子。
claims.evidence: passing the then-current UNIX timestamp to srand48(); drand48 seeded with the Unix timestamp, which fell in 1997–98
claims.note: '逐一嘗試' and the English-sentence legend contrast were not confirmed in the returned extract; core claim confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 作者估計種子選擇的自由度「barely 30 bits」，不足以支撐 Bernstein 與 Lange 在 2017 年描述的攻擊；他也承認有效種子比公開的多出約兩倍，找不到好的解釋。
claims.evidence: the NSA 'would have had barely 30 bits of freedom'; Bernstein and Lange technique could have used 70 bits ... no longer plausible; 'roughly twice as many valid seeds as were published' ... team 'found no good fit'
claims.note: '多出約兩倍' was ambiguous (2x vs +2x); lede reworded after review to 「數量約是公開種子的兩倍」.

claims.claim_text: 作者 2017 年買了 Matrix CoolRunner 卻沒做成；當時自製的 NAND 程式器走並列埠，他估計傾印要超過 30 分鐘，2026 年改用約 5 英鎊的 Raspberry Pi Pico，傾印只要幾秒。
claims.evidence: I purchased a Matrix CoolRunner Rev D back in 2017. ... building my own NAND / JTAG programmer using the printer port (LPT port) ... If I had ever got this working it would have taken over 30 minutes to dump the NAND. I do not recall the reason but I did not manage to pull this off. ... The dump operation then only took a handful of seconds to run. / The Raspberry Pi Pico microcontroller, released in 2021 for £5
claims.note: Checker round 1 verified a 'because LPT' causal compression; direct read shows the author says he does not recall why it failed. The lede no longer claims a cause (round 2 correction).

claims.claim_text: 文章提到的故障注入是送出約 100 奈秒的電源脈衝，Pico 的計時解析度約 7.5 奈秒；作者也說純軟體的攻擊上週出現，讓這些努力「somewhat moot」。
claims.evidence: a short pulse of energy (~ 100 nanoseconds); effective timing resolution of ~7.5 nanoseconds due to the 133 MHz clock; a software-only exploit for the Xbox 360 dropped just last week, rendering my years of effort somewhat moot.
claims.note: The 'mr instruction writes 0' detail (prior researchers' technique) was dropped from the lede; remaining figures verified against the page text.

claims.claim_text: 論文自報在 BrowseComp-Plus 上比最強的檢索與預計算基線高 33 個百分點，零樣本到未見領域的 BRIGHT 平均提升 31 點。
claims.evidence: outperforms the strongest retrieval and precomputation baselines by 33 percentage points; generalizes zero-shot to unseen domains on BRIGHT with a 31-point average accuracy improvement

claims.claim_text: 作者說前期建置成本會由重複查詢攤提。
claims.evidence: amortizes upfront construction costs across repeated queries

claims.claim_text: 文章的出發點是「verifying who operates it creates accountability, but trust depends on what it does next」。
claims.evidence: verifying who operates it creates accountability, but trust depends on what it does next

claims.claim_text: 系統目前內部使用，Cloudflare 打算推廣給所有客戶並在 Radar 公開分數；文章沒有給出數值門檻或樣本數。
claims.evidence: We are already using this system internally ...; plans to make the system available to all Cloudflare customers ... share scores publicly on Radar; no numeric thresholds or sample sizes given

claims.claim_text: 以約 25.1 萬顆 star 的 react/react 為例，抓完整曲線的請求從約 2,511 次降到約 24 次。
claims.evidence: For react/react, that's about 24 requests instead of about 2,511; react/react, with about 251,000 stars, took about 2,511 requests

claims.claim_text: 不再回傳 stargazer 身分（有人爬取名單做垃圾訊息與釣魚）... 先用索引過的 created_at 範圍縮小列數再聚合 ... 忙碌的週仍可能很昂貴
claims.evidence: bad actors started scraping public stargazer lists for spam and phishing campaigns; translates page and per_page into an indexed created_at range; A week with an unusually large number of stars can therefore still produce a slow or expensive query.
